verdict.rationale: Canny documents a hosted feedback site/Portal where customers submit feedback directly, and the basic install step is only adding a link to it. However, tying feedback to user accounts requires installing a JavaScript SDK, and the 'no engineering' claim in the evidence refers to the MCP server, not portal setup. Missing for 10: documentation of a no-code portal setup or configuration flow for PMs, user identification without developer work (SDK/SSO), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can set up a public-facing feedback portal without engineering help

citations.quote: or directly from customers on your Portal
In your application, add a link to your Canny feedback site. Put the link somewhere it's easy to find.
